subject.title: feat(plugins): add final tool input policies

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent public, restrict-only final tool-input policy API together with operator-configured fail-closed activation semantics?
rationale: The patch adds a new plugin SDK contract and an opt-in configuration mode that can intentionally stop tool execution; code review cannot choose the long-term supported policy and upgrade contract without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the security seam after proof
options.body: Adopt the manifest-gated API and fail-closed behavior after a rebased head demonstrates the documented pass, deny, and required-policy failure paths.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the enforcement concept but reduce or revise the exported API and operator requirement semantics before accepting a permanent plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Defer to follow-up design work
options.body: Pause this branch until the broader action/resource/provenance contract is settled with the related security design work.

recommendation.title: Approve the security seam after proof
recommendation.body: Adopt the manifest-gated API and fail-closed behavior after a rebased head demonstrates the documented pass, deny, and required-policy failure paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and concentrates the proposed API and operator-facing behavior in one design.
